notes: Subject names in Hindi are interface translations, not official titles.
Chapter titles are listed only where they were read from the book itself (maths). Other subjects show the official book titles and chapter counts only.
Board coverage: NCERT books are prescribed by CBSE and, per an official 2021-22 JCERT document, followed by JAC for Class 9. Neither board's current scheme of studies was checked.
Streams for Classes 11-12 are suggestions to help pick subjects. NCERT does not define streams; schools and boards set the allowed combinations.
